about:
Wyoming Fabrication & Machine has operated from Evanston, Wyoming since 1990. The company was established to provide steel fabrication services to the region, and its founders set out to build a shop capable of handling both straightforward and one-of-a-kind custom work. Ownership details are not publicly disclosed.

Today the shop delivers custom steel design, fabrication, and repair of steel equipment, plus protective coating for steel structures. Its capabilities extend beyond fabrication to include machine work, demolition, scrap steel removal, and stock steel sales, maintaining an inventory of stock steel for immediate sale. The company describes its team as skilled and well-equipped, though it does not disclose facility size, headcount, or production volumes.

name: YellowLite - Solar Panels in Ohio
old_description: Choose a solar installation company with proven experience, in-house installers, and quality warranties. The best solar companies handle design, financing, and installation under one roof. Since 2009, YellowLite has been Ohio’s trusted solar installer, completing over 3,500 successful renewable energy transitions across the Midwest.
about:
YellowLite was established in 2009 in Cleveland, Ohio, by former solar distribution executives who wanted to make solar energy more accessible to the masses. The company operates from its Cleveland headquarters with additional offices in Columbus and Cincinnati, serving customers across Ohio, Indiana, Michigan, and Pennsylvania.

The firm provides turnkey solar photovoltaic solutions, handling design, engineering, permitting, installation, and performance monitoring for residential, commercial, and agricultural projects. It also installs energy storage systems and offers repair and maintenance services. Since inception, YellowLite has completed over 4,000 solar installations across the Midwest.

Homeowners, businesses, and farms make up the core customer base. Residential clients receive rooftop and ground-mount arrays, while commercial customers include facilities seeking to reduce operating costs. Agricultural projects often leverage USDA REAP grants, and the company supports energy storage for grid resilience.

YellowLite emphasizes its NABCEP-certified team, in-house installers, and a mission to democratize solar energy. Differentiators include $0-down leasing with maintenance included, live project tracking, and community initiatives such as food bank donations and river cleanups.

name: Yoder Furniture Co.
old_description: Selling handcrafted furniture since 1988, we offer solid-wood furniture from Amish and Mennonite builders across the Midwest. We have hand-selected a unique set of builders to bring our customers the highest quality furniture. Be sure to visit our store locations, Yoder Furniture Co. in Yoder, KS or Country Home Furnishings, Pleasantview, KS (5 miles west of Hutchinson, KS).
about:
Yoder Furniture Co. operates from two locations in central Kansas: its namesake store in Yoder and Country Home Furnishings in Pleasantview, five miles west of Hutchinson. The business traces its roots to March 1988, when Austin and Linda Miller opened Country Home Furnishings as a small storefront in Pleasantview. In the fall of 2002 they added the Yoder Furniture Co. location in Yoder, KS. The company remains family-owned and operated.

The retailer specializes in solid-wood furniture handcrafted by Amish and Mennonite builders across the Midwest. Rather than manufacturing, Yoder Furniture Co. hand-selects a network of independent shops to source a range of styles, wood species, and finishes. In addition to furniture, the stores carry home decor, quilts, gifts, table linens, coffee, candles, and canned goods such as jams and salsas.

The customer base consists primarily of retail shoppers visiting the two Kansas showrooms seeking heirloom-quality pieces for residential use. By working directly with the builders, the company offers a broad selection of customizable options without acting as a producer itself.

That family-owned ethos and curated builder network remain the core of its value proposition.

name: York Haven Fabricators
old_description: York Haven Fabricators (YHFAB) delivers custom fabrication services with precision results. Leveraging decades of manufacturing experience, state-of-the-art manufacturing technologies and expert automation, we combine sheet metal fabrication, heavy gauge forming, and welding processes with CNC machining and finishing operations in a single, highly integrated facility.
about:
York Haven Fabricators (YHFAB) operates from York Haven, Pennsylvania. The company was established in 1998 by Henry Shefet as a division of Daisy Data, a ruggedized computer manufacturer he founded in 1982. The fabrication division expanded the business's manufacturing knowledge into custom metal fabrication. In 2025, YHFAB became a subsidiary of S&W Metal Products, a Pennsylvania fabricator with roots dating to 1946.

YHFAB provides integrated sheet metal fabrication, heavy-gauge forming, welding, CNC machining, and finishing in a 160,000-square-foot facility. Processes include fiber laser cutting, CNC press brake and robotic bending, CNC turret punching, plate rolling, MIG/TIG/spot and robotic welding, surface finishing, and CNC milling (vertical, horizontal, 5-axis) and turning (multi-axis, live tooling). The shop runs 160-plus pieces of production equipment, employs 109-plus people, and ships more than 16,000 line items annually.

The company serves OEMs and manufacturers in energy (oil, gas, renewables), material handling, factory automation, automotive (OEM, Tier 1, Tier 2), commercial and industrial lighting, electronic enclosures, military, medical, and packaging sectors. It produces precision parts and assemblies for material handling systems, automation equipment, lighting fixtures, automotive components, and electronic housings.

YHFAB emphasizes a single-facility integration of fabrication and machining, backed by an ISO 9001:2015 quality system maintained since 2012. Inspection relies on a Virtek LaserQC system (±0.002 in) and a FARO Edge portable CMM (±0.0014 in). The firm also highlights its design-for-manufacture engineering and experience with custom factory automation systems.

old_description: The decision to transfer your tooling may be a difficult one.  Perhaps your current supplier is not meeting your quality standards, or they lack the current capacity to meet your order requirements.  With over 500 successful mold transfers since 1985, York Imperial Plastics specializes in the execution of transfer tooling including those requiring rework and modifications.
about:
York Imperial Plastics, Inc. is a second-generation family-owned and operated plastic injection molding facility founded in 1985 in York, Pennsylvania. The company began as a custom molding operation and has since expanded into an all-inclusive service provider for tooling transfers, production molding, and value-added assembly.

The facility specializes in plastic injection molding from prototype through high-volume production, with a noted expertise in mold transfer and rework — over 500 successful transfers have been executed since 1985. Capabilities include multi-cavity high-production tool design, master unit die (MUD) systems, in-house assembly and packaging, and daily direct shipping of finished goods. Quality processes encompass APQP, PPAP, first-article inspection, CMM and optical measurement, color spectrophotometry, statistical process control, and moisture analysis.

York Imperial serves customers across a range of industries requiring custom plastic components, though specific sectors are not publicly listed. The company positions itself as a one-stop shop for manufacturers needing tooling construction, production molding, and logistics support under one roof.

The business emphasizes its family-values culture and a "Made in America Tool Warranty" that accompanies every tool built in-house. Its ISO 9001 certification and proactive quality planning are cited as differentiators, along with the ability to manage complex transfers that other suppliers may decline.

name: Yost Foods
old_description: At Yost Foods, we’re a family-owned ingredient manufacturer that’s been creating custom dry and wet ingredient systems on an industrial scale since 1991. We work side by side with food manufacturers to take products from initial concept through to consistent, reliable production.
about:
Yost Foods is a family-owned custom ingredient manufacturer based in Brunswick, Ohio. Founded in 1991 by Bill Yost, the company began as an industrial food brokerage before evolving into a manufacturer of dry and wet ingredient systems for food producers.

The company produces custom dry blends — such as snack seasonings, dry sauces, and snack bases — and wet systems including marinades, sauces, hot sauces, purees, and kettle-cooked bases. Its facility features multiple production rooms separated by process type: liquid mixing for sauces and marinades, ribbon and paddle mixing for dry blends, and kettle cooking for caramelized sugars, purees, and pepper blends. Automation supports repeatable batches and scalable output from early-stage runs to high-volume production.

Yost serves national food manufacturers across categories including sauces, dressings, and marinades; refrigerated and ready-to-eat foods; frozen meals and pizzas; snacks, candy, and nuts; and ice cream and frozen desserts. The team works directly with R&D departments, food scientists, and culinary innovators to develop formulations that perform consistently in conventional and alternative product lines.

The company emphasizes collaborative development, technical expertise from food scientists and production specialists, fast sampling and rapid revisions, custom formulations with line-trial support, and consistency at scale through process control. It also provides clean-label and certification guidance for kosher, organic, gluten-free, non-GMO, and no-sugar-added claims, along with flexible packaging in bags, bag-in-box, drums, pails, and totes. A family-owned, long-term mindset drives a relationship-driven, accountable, and customer-first culture.

name: ZEN BY DESIGN
old_description: Zen By Design is a Scottsdale, Arizona, maker of meditation chairs and other meditation furniture, established in 2001. Its products, including The Tantra Chair, are built by hand in Scottsdale from eco-friendly materials, with each piece of wood and each fabric selected individually by the company's artisans. The chairs are designed to give back support and keep the spine aligned during long sitting sessions. According to the company, tens of thousands of meditators worldwide have bought its chairs over more than two decades of production.
about:
Zen By Design was founded in 2001 in Scottsdale, Arizona, as a family-run venture dedicated to creating meditation furniture. The company began with the intention of bringing greater comfort and harmony to meditation practice, addressing the physical discomfort that often distracts practitioners during long sitting sessions.

The company handcrafts a line of meditation chairs—including the Tantra Chair, Anahata, Rama, Samurai, and the portable Zenfu zafu—as well as meditation candles. Each piece is built in Scottsdale from eco-friendly materials, with every wood component and fabric individually selected by artisans who have been with the company since its early years. Over more than two decades, Zen By Design has produced chairs for tens of thousands of meditators worldwide.

The furniture serves individual meditators, yoga studios, ashrams, and meditation centers across nearly every country. Notable clients have included Deepak Chopra, Andrew Weil, the Oprah Winfrey Show, Jack Canfield, and the Dalai Lama, though the company emphasizes its commitment to every customer regardless of prominence.

Zen By Design says its differentiators are ergonomic designs that provide sacral tilt and back support to encourage longer meditation, a family-oriented workplace that retains skilled artisans, and a 100 percent customer satisfaction policy with support available seven days a week, 365 days a year.

name: Zephyrus Electronics & Fabrication
old_description: Founded in 1985 on a commitment to innovation, durability, and customer satisfaction, Zephyrus serves as a one-stop shop—streamlining production, reducing lead times, and ensuring top-tier quality from concept to completion. Our integrated approach means we can design, build, and deliver smarter, more efficient solutions that meet the demands of modern industry.
about:
Zephyrus Electronics & Fabrication was founded in 1985 in Tulsa, Oklahoma. The company began as a combined electronics and metal fabrication shop, aiming to provide integrated manufacturing services.

The company operates two primary divisions: electronics manufacturing and metal fabrication. The electronics side offers in-house PCB design and assembly, wire cutting, stripping, and terminal pressing, plus custom wire harness assembly. The metal fabrication division runs a dedicated facility equipped with a Strippit 1000xp 20 CNC turret punch, an AMADA 8025 NC press brake, Miller Syncrowave 300 welders, and a Timesaver 22 series deburring and finishing system. Additional services include metal and plastic engraving using Gravograph IS7000/IS8000 and Epilog Laser Fusion systems, paint filling, and silk screening. The integrated setup allows rapid prototyping and quick turnaround on design changes.

Zephyrus serves original equipment manufacturers and industrial customers across a range of sectors, supplying custom control panels, complex wiring harnesses, and precision-machined enclosures. The company emphasizes a single-source model for complete build requirements.

Founded on a commitment to innovation, durability, and customer satisfaction, Zephyrus positions itself as a one-stop shop that streamlines production, reduces lead times, and ensures quality from concept to completion.

name: Zim's Bagging Company
old_description: Since 1964, Zim's Bagging Company has been converting and printing film, foam and bubble packaging materials. We differentiate ourselves from others in our industry by specializing in value-added, custom designed, non-standard packaging.
about:
Zim's Bagging Company was founded in 1964 in Prichard, West Virginia. The business began as a converter and printer of film, foam, and bubble packaging materials and has operated continuously from its West Virginia location for six decades.

The company runs two production sites—a Main Facility and a SoftPack Facility—equipped for forming, folding, cutting, and sealing plastic film, foam, and bubble roll stock into bags and pouches. Its capabilities include flexographic printing up to 10 colors on a 59-inch web using a W&H Miraflex II press, as well as simpler line printing. Custom features such as tapes, handles, wickets, punched holes, labels, and bar codes can be added, and the firm offers photo-quality front-and-back printing on roll stock for automated form-and-fill lines. Core product lines encompass poly bags, wicket bags, PowerPack Mailer Bags, printed roll stock, and foam and bubble products.

Zim's serves customers in automotive, e-commerce, food, home and garden, industrial, and medical markets, supplying custom packaging tailored to each sector's requirements.

The company emphasizes its focus on value-added, non-standard packaging designs, citing more than 55 years of experience in the flexible packaging industry as a key differentiator.
